findings.title: Player/MiniPlayer/Driving TrackMetadata and Artwork ownership was ambiguous
findings.cause: Generic metadata components named Room/MediaStore local browse projection as source without requiring the current rendered media item be selected from the service-acknowledged PlaybackSnapshot; an engineer could render stale selected row as the playing item.
findings.resolution: CMP-07/CMP-08 now explicitly bind Player/Driving/MiniPlayer current-item key to PlaybackGateway.snapshot.currentItem; Room/MediaStore resolves display-only metadata for that key. Screen Specs aligned. No extra playback or queue owner.
findings.acceptanceEvidence: AI-assisted doc inspection + Phase 11 machine assertion on exact component sections; actual ViewModel/Media3 switch tests remain PH11-MIN-002
findings.downstreamGate: No Phase 11 defect remains; future implementation test is PH11-MIN-002.

findings.title: CMP-10 SearchField source-of-truth conflated ephemeral query and Room-derived results
findings.cause: Generic component owner text named MediaStore/Room for SearchField as a whole; despite screen-level correct guidance, this could result in persisting or logging the user's private search query.
findings.resolution: CMP-10 now binds transient query/focus state solely to SearchViewModel; SearchLibraryUseCase/Room owns derived results, MediaStore verifies identity. Query banned from Room/DataStore/logs/analytics/crash evidence. Screen Specs aligned.
findings.acceptanceEvidence: AI-assisted source boundary review + Phase 11 machine assertion on query/privacy terms; runtime privacy-negative tests remain PH11-MIN-002
findings.downstreamGate: No Phase 11 contract defect remains; future implementation test is PH11-MIN-002.

findings.title: Actual Compose 100/150/200% reflow, TalkBack and target/focus behavior is not yet tested
findings.downstreamGate: Before corresponding Android screen feature DoD / release candidate: run all 65 Phase-7 cases on real builds with sanitized TalkBack traces, 200% fonts, keyboard/Back, 48dp and 64/72/56dp checks.
findings.nonblockingWhy: Phase 11 evaluates static design and implementation handoff only. Existing accessibility semantics requirements are preserved; runtime correctness is not certified.

findings.title: Real Media3/controller and STT lifecycle, malformed media, interruption and OEM/vehicle tests not run
findings.owner: Issue #4 Android implementation + QA / Field Beta
findings.downstreamGate: Before release candidate/Field Beta: verify service ACK and currentItem metadata, no optimistic queue, query not stored/logged, 6s/one Retry/one confirm, route Safe Paused and Android 10/12/14+ Pixel/Samsung/Xiaomi + at least 3 vehicle/head-unit combinations.
findings.nonblockingWhy: No playable APK is part of high-fidelity artifact review; all implementation and physical test requirements remain test obligations.

findings.title: Provider-specific cloud STT consent/retention/Legal evidence unavailable
